meta.title: Ouachita County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget report as filed with the state. It is titled "2026 Proposed" and its only 2026 column is "Request 2026", so these are the amounts asked for; the document does not show the quorum court's final vote. Some funds move money to other funds ("Transfers out"), so those dollars can appear in two funds.
